camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeHoneyPotSuspStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --StatisticsKeyType vpcInstanceId --StatisticsDays 30 --From honeypot
description_en: Queries information about the top 5 VPCs or assets ranked by the number of security alerts
description_zh: 查询安全告警数排名前5的VPC或资产信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-honey-pot-susp-statistics --from honeypot --statistics-key-type vpcInstanceId --statistics-days 30 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHoneyPotSuspStatistics

parameters.help_en: The source of the request. Set the value to honeypot
parameters.help_zh: 指定发起请求的来源，固定值为honeypot
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The Asset Type to query. Valid values:
vpcInstanceId: VPC-connected instance
uuid: server
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要查询的资产类型。取值：
vpcInstanceId：VPC实例
uuid：服务器
parameters.name: statistics_key_type

parameters.help_en: The time range of the data to query. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 指定需要查询的数据的时间范围。单位为天
parameters.name: statistics_days

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues

Count.description_en: The total number of security alerts on the asset
